description: This file defines an Android Activity named KeyChainDemoActivity that manages SSL key chain installation, key retrieval, and server controls within a sample Android application demonstrating KeyChain API functionalities.

classes.name: KeyChainDemoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing keychain installation, certificate display, SSL server control, and SSL testing functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and sets up button click handlers for keychain installation, server control, and SSL testing.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intent to stop SSL server if indicated.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Callback invoked after user selects a key alias; saves alias and updates UI.

methods.name: getAlias
methods.description: Retrieves stored key alias from shared preferences.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Stores selected key alias into shared preferences.

methods.name: printInfo
methods.description: Displays certificate chain and private key information on UI.

methods.name: installPkcs12
methods.description: Loads PKCS#12 file from assets and initiates keychain installation.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from keychain installation intent.

methods.name: chooseCert
methods.description: Prompts user to choose a key certificate.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves certificate chain for given alias.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves private key for given alias.

methods.name: isKeyChainAccessible
methods.description: Checks if keychain with current alias is accessible.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts a local SSL web server service.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the local SSL web server service.

methods.name: disableKeyChainButton
methods.description: Updates UI to indicate keychain is installed and disables the install button.
